title: E3 event
description: The only data that leaves the Raspberry Pi. Never contains raw audio (proposal sections 1.5 and 1.12).

event_id.description: Generated on the Pi, so retries after an outage don't create duplicates

detected_at.description: When the Pi detected the event (UTC, ISO 8601)

elapsed_seconds.description: Seconds since detection at the time the event was sent

details.description: Small extra info, e.g. {"label": "thud"}. Never audio or transcripts.
